description: This file defines the EcuQuery interface within the com.romraider.logger.ecu.comms.query package, specifying methods related to ECU query operations such as retrieving addresses, byte data, hex representations, and setting responses.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns an array of String addresses for the ECU query.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the response data as a byte array.

methods.name: getHex
methods.description: Returns a hexadecimal String representation of the response data.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response data with the provided byte array.
